'''''ONE Fight Night 48: Erdogan vs. Elliott''''' was a [[combat sport]]s event produced by [[ONE Championship]] that took place on October 3, 2026, at [[Lumpinee Boxing Stadium]] in [[Bangkok]], Thailand.<ref>{{Cite web |title=ONE Fight Night 48: Erdogan vs. Elliott |url=https://www.onefc.com/events/onefightnight48/ |access-date=2026-08-19 |website=ONE Championship – The Home of Martial Arts |language=en-US}}</ref>

===Background===
A heavyweight bout between Shamil Erdogan and Paul Elliott headlined the event.

At the weigh-ins, one fighter failed to hydration test and missed weight for their respective fights:<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-10-02 |title=ผลชั่งน้ำหนักและวัดระดับน้ำ ศึก ONE Fight Night 48: ชามิล vs. พอล|url=https://www.onefc.com/th/news/weight-and-hydration-results-of-one-fight-night-48/ |access-date=2026-10-02 |website=ONE Championship – The Home Of Martial Arts |language=th-TH}}</ref>
*Antonio Cesar weighted in at 138.6 pounds, 3.6 pounds over the flyweight limit and he was fined 30 percent of his purse which went to Joshua Pereira.

===Bonus awards===
The following fighters received $50,000 bonuses:
*'''Performance of the Night: Shamil Erdogan'''

'''''ONE Samurai 4''''' was a [[combat sport]]s event produced by [[ONE Championship]] that took place on October 17, 2026, at [[Ariake Arena]] in [[Tokyo]], Japan.<ref>{{Cite web |title=ONE Samurai 4 |url=https://www.onefc.com/events/one-samurai-4/ |access-date=2026-07-08 |website=ONE Championship – The Home of Martial Arts |language=en-US}}</ref>

===Background===
A [[ONE Bantamweight Kickboxing World Championship]] bout between current champion (also former [[ONE Bantamweight Muay Thai World Championship|ONE Bantamweight]] and [[ONE Flyweight Muay Thai World Championship|Flyweight Muay Thai World Champion]]) [[Jonathan Haggerty]] and former champion [[Hiroki Akimoto]] headlined the event.

A ONE Atomweight Muay Thai World Championship bout between current champion [[Nadaka Yoshinari]] and Rifdean Masdor served as the event.

===Bonus awards===
The following fighters received bonuses:
*'''Performance of the Night ($95,000): Jonathan Haggerty and Nadaka Yoshinari'''
*'''Performance of the Night ($45,000): Sinsamut Klinmee'''
*'''Performance of the Night ($9,500): Kota Abe, Toki Tamaru, Shoma Okumura, Ryoto Nishiyama and Masaki Takeura'''
